{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Filter to treatment arm only
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "treatment"]

# Step 4: Cross-tabulate sex and severity
severity_sex = pd.crosstab(df_treatment["sex"], df_treatment["severity"])

# Compute total counts per sex
n_f = severity_sex.loc["F"].sum()
n_m = severity_sex.loc["M"].sum()

# Compute percentages
p_f_mild_mod = (severity_sex.loc["F", "mild"] + severity_sex.loc["F", "moderate"]) / n_f * 100
p_m_severe = severity_sex.loc["M", "severe"] / n_m * 100

print(f"Female patients: {n_f} total, {p_f_mild_mod:.1f}% mild/moderate")
print(f"Male patients: {n_m} total, {p_m_severe:.1f}% severe")"}
